title: orchis papilionacea subsp. rubra
intro: Orchis papilionacea subsp. rubra, commonly known as the Lady's Slipper Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is known for its unique, slipper-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Orchis papilionacea subsp. rubra include its ability to improve kidney function, reduce inflammation, and act as an antidiabetic agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system.
